typography.instructions: Use Outfit for all Headings to give a technical yet polished look. Use JetBrains Mono for agent logs, status indicators, and numbers. Do NOT use Inter for headings.

colors.instructions: Rely heavily on deep blacks and dark charcoals. Use the cyan and amber purely as accents for active states, borders, or critical information. Avoid purple/AI slop gradients.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border color on all panels. Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). Implement 'Tracing Beam' on the currently active Agent Orchestra card.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Replace soft shadows with 1px solid strokes or 2px 'Inner Glow' highlights. Use drop-shadow glow (e.g., drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,240,255,0.5)]) ONLY for high-energy text or critical active states.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate subtle CSS scanlines (repeating-linear-gradient) for the Failure Museum and Judge Simulator to enhance the retro-futurism/terminal feel.

component_name.strategy: Shadcn/UI components heavily stripped of their default 'Vercel-look' borders/shadows to match the brutalist terminal vibe.

specifics.inputs: Must look like command-line prompts. Monospace fonts, high contrast.
specifics.cards: Sharp, cardless look. 1px borders. Use border-collapse style layouts for dense grids.
specifics.buttons: Sharp corners. High contrast on hover (e.g., bg-cyan text-black).
specifics.charts: Recharts for the Reality Check radar chart.
specifics.tabs: Override default h-9 to h-auto. Sharp active states without soft pills.

grids.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4. Every pixel must be utilized. No jagged bottoms. Override default stretch with align-self.

layouts.home: Minimalist hero. Large 'ProtoPilot' heading. Terminal-style input field taking center stage. Sample prompts as mono pills below.
layouts.live_dashboard: Bento grid structure. Left column (col-span-3): 6 Agent orchestra cards. Center (col-span-6): 3D Knowledge Graph + Live Terminal Logs. Right (col-span-3): Citations Panel.
layouts.judge_simulator: 3 equal columns for 3 AI Judges. Top row houses live scoring (Clarity/Depth/Confidence gauges).
layouts.failure_museum: Grid of 'dead repo' cards. Red/Amber accents. Use terminal error styles for the 'AI autopsy' details.
layouts.reality_check: Central Radar chart. Surrounding metrics (Skills, Budget, Time, Team). Bold CTA for 'Ship It'.
layouts.time_machine: Horizontal timeline spanning 5 years past (muted) to 2 years future (cyan glowing).
layouts.ship_it_modal: Full-screen overlay simulating a fast terminal build process.
layouts.project_workspace: List/Table layout of past projects with status badges.
layouts.footer: Must display Team name: 'Silence', College: 'Ajeenkya DY Patil', Team ID: '0A7DD70427DE'. Mono font, text-xs.

motion.interactions: Snappy, micro-interactions (0.15s) on hover. Hover states must explicitly set text color.
motion.agent_orchestra: Pulse animations for actively speaking/thinking agents. Staggered typing effects for live logs.

accessibility.contrast: Text below 18px needs 4.5:1 ratio. Interactive elements 3:1 against adjacent colors.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast, eg: ring-2 ring-cyan.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='ship-it-button').

media.images: Use cautiously. Apply monochrome or high-contrast filters to match the dark UI.

3d_libraries.usage: Use for the '3D Knowledge Graph' visualization. Must set background to transparent (rgba(0,0,0,0)). Nodes should be Tech Cyan, links should be dark grey.

failure_museum_bg.description: Close up of computer screen with data - to overlay as low opacity tech texture.

judge_avatar.description: Shadowy figure in mask - use as avatar for the harshest AI Judge.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'react-force-graph-3d' for the knowledge graph.
Install 'recharts' for the Reality Check radar chart.
Install 'lucide-react' for all icons. Absolutely NO EMOJIS.
Create Shadcn-like components manually or customize them heavily with sharp corners and terminal aesthetics.
Use deep blacks and cyan/amber/green accents. Do not use generic purple SaaS gradients.
Ensure all 7 screens plus the workspace list are implemented or visually distinct.
Do NOT use complete transparent background in headers/overlays; use solid dark colors to prevent readability issues.
Include Team Silence, Ajeenkya DY Patil, and Team ID 0A7DD70427DE in the footer or about section.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) ONLY where appropriate, but prefer solid dark surfaces with 1px borders for this terminal theme.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like sharp cornered buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
Always add GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES
